messages.subject: SRM data, from peptides to protein
parts:
Hello,

Could someone please explain me how this software sum the data obtained from peptide measurements into protein data? We have analyzed multiple peptides per protein and in the end of the statistical analysis we only got a value for the protein itself, which is very good, but could you please tell me how is this procedure works?
